title: Movement feel
question: Does this feel right as the baseline? Tab compares with the bake-off's movement; F1 tunes it live.

title: Ability triggers resonance
question: The 2019 design: using an ability makes its color resonate for 1.5s. Does a dash into a red wall read as 'passing through', not a glitch?

title: Choose your color
question: The bake-off design: switch cycles a persistent active color, and only its ability works. Is losing the other ability while red is selected annoying or fine?

title: Hold to resonate
question: A third option: abilities always work, but resonating costs a held breath meter. Does metering the 'pass through' moment feel better or worse than the other two?
